title: Erdtree Tower
subtitle: ERDTREE TOWER
tagline: Choose a path. Take an oath. Ascend.
tips: Paths and Choices
Check your supplies before choosing a route. Elites and shops each have their value.
Take an Oath
Oaths now grant benefits without penalties. Deepening also grants a Sacred Tear.
Weapon Preferences
Upgrade preferences in the Journey Archive for up to five times the selection weight.
Your Build
Check ember stacks and bonuses in the build panel to plan your growth.
Class Legacy
View class mastery and starting talismans at Roundtable Hold.
Armor Transmog
Mix and match appearances freely. Defense still comes from your equipped armor.
Affixes and Skills
Rarity is only part of a weapon. Choose affixes and skills that suit your playstyle.
Challenge the Merchant
Defeating a merchant has a 30% chance to summon a Bell Bearing Hunter.
Moonlight Spring
Choose one: restore HP, restore FP, or take 800 runes.
Scarab Hunt
Each attempt costs 500 runes. You can try up to three times at each event.
Mystery Boxes and Reforging
Find new equipment in mystery boxes, or reforge your right-hand weapon's affixes.
Fellow Travelers
Before co-op, make sure everyone uses the same mod, resource, and Seamless versions.
Soul Snare Pot
Summoners can attempt a capture by hitting a weakened enemy with a thrown pot.
Capture Timing
Capture chances rise as enemy HP falls. At 10% HP or less, capture is guaranteed.
Explosive Chests
Triple Chests may explode. Watch your HP, or move out of the blast area.
Lingering Grace
Grace also covers solo event explosions. Previously triggered events cannot pay out again.
Shared Kills
With Soul Eater in co-op, damaging an enemy earns souls even if an ally finishes it.
Godslayer
Gain one stack per elite or boss victory. In co-op, you do not need the final hit.
Growing Spell Power
The general damage bonuses from Soul Eater and Godslayer also boost spells.
Execution Chain
Execution Chain boosts critical attacks, not ordinary attacks or spell hits.
Frenzied Flame
Consecutive hits build attack power, but taking damage clears the stacks.
A Place to Rest
Tent grants one free flask refill at each campfire without spending a service use.
Mind over Matter
Mind over Matter adds maximum HP based on maximum FP.
Glintblade
The Astrologer ember sends a blade after a spell hit, at most once per cast.
Frost Shackles
After frostbite triggers, Frost Shackles briefly reduce enemy speed and damage.
Protect Your Summons
At victory, each summon group is checked separately for surviving members.
Summon Again
Summoners can call new spirit ashes after all their current spirits have fallen.
Spirit Resonance
A living summon empowers your own damage through Spirit Resonance, including spells.
Flask Placement
Flasks can go in your pouch. Arrange your quick items to suit your controls.
Chalice Echo
Drinking a flask can also briefly increase damage and reduce incoming damage.
An Envious World
With Envious World enabled, drinking a flask also heals enemies for 8% HP.
Thorned Enemies
Thorned enemies reflect part of your damage. Keep an eye on your own HP.
Prepare for Danger
High rewards can mean high risk. Check your flasks and runes before choosing a route.
Class Rewards
New runs use class-specific ember pools. Another class may receive different options.
Lasting Growth
Soul Eater and Godslayer stacks last for the run, including after Lingering Grace.
Choose What Fits
Choose rewards that support your build, rather than judging by rarity alone.
Physick Supplies
Physicks are stackable consumables. Each use spends one bottle.
Beyond the Limit
Weapons can still use tower upgrades after reaching their original upgrade cap.
Update Together
All players should update the mod DLL and scene assets together before co-op.
Read the Affixes
Affixes can change how a boss fights. Read its effects before committing.
Taking a Break
Use journey suspension before leaving. Resume the same journey with your party.
Tower Handbook
Open the launcher Wiki whenever you need a reminder about classes or embers.
